papers.evidence: 张量积表示上的注意力机制，类似结构化联想记忆模块
papers.tldr: 深度学习在系统性泛化上仍有显著不足，尤其是组合泛化，即面对已知变化因子的新组合时，标准神经网络常依赖统计相关而难以泛化。为此，本文提出一种在张量积表示上运行的注意力机制TPR-Attention，为网络引入显式的结构归纳偏置。在组合任务的受控实验中，该方法在泛化性能上优于现有架构组件，表明显式组合结构对神经注意力有积极价值，为系统性泛化提供了可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: Systematic generalization remains a significant challenge in deep learning. In particular, combinatorial generalization - generalizing to new configurations of known factors of variation - is effortless for humans but difficult for standard neural architectures that rely on statistical correlations rather than explicit structural representations. We introduce a new architectural component that embeds structured inductive bias into deep learning: an attention mechanism operating over tensor-product representations (TPRs). Through controlled experiments on compositional tasks, we show that this TPR-attention mechanism outperforms existing architectural components in combinatorial generalization. These results highlight the value of integrating explicit compositional structure into neural attention and point toward a promising path for models capable of systematic generalization.
